SELECT 
	documentcode = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
	InvCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
	SL.Date, 
	I.CustomICode, 
	I.Name,
	SoldQty=SUM(SD.LooseQty + SD.PackQty * SD.PackUnits),
	SoldBonus=SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	SaleValue=SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.PackQty * SD.PackUnits) * (SD.SalePrice-SD.ItemFlatDisc) * 
			(1- SD.DiscPerc *.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01)),
	BonusValue=SUM(SD.BonusQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc *.01) * 
			(1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01)),
	Salesman=(SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SL.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode),
	U.UserName,
	Customer=AC.Name

FROM
	SaleLedger SL,
	SaleDetail SD,
	Item I,
	Users U,
	Accounts AC
WHERE
	SL.Date >= :ar_StartDate AND SL.Date <= :ar_EndDate AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	SL.SalesmanCode = U.UserCode AND
	SL.CustCode=AC.AccCode
GROUP BY
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SD.ICode,
	SL.Date,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	SL.SManCode,
	U.UserName,
	AC.Name
HAVING
	SUM(SD.BonusQty) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	documentcode = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
	InvCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
	SL.Date,
	I.CustomICode, 
	I.Name,
	SoldQty=SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	SoldBonus=SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	SaleValue=SUM((SD.LooseQty) * (SD.SalePrice-SD.ItemFlatDisc) * 
			(1- SD.DiscPerc *.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01)),
	BonusValue=SUM(SD.BonusQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc *.01) * 
			(1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01)),
	Salesman=(SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SL.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode),
	U.UserName,
	Customer=AC.Name

FROM
	SaleLedger SL,
	SaleInvDetail SD,
	Item I,
	Users U,
	Accounts AC
WHERE
	SL.ImpactInventory='N' AND
	SL.Date >= :ar_StartDate AND SL.Date <= :ar_EndDate AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	SL.SalesmanCode = U.UserCode AND
	SL.CustCode=AC.AccCode
GROUP BY
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SD.ICode,
	SL.Date,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	SL.SManCode,
	U.UserName,
	AC.Name
HAVING
	SUM(SD.BonusQty) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
	documentcode = 'SR-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SRInvCode, 10))), 
	InvCode=SL.SRInvCode,
	SL.Date,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	SoldQty=-SUM(SD.LooseQty + SD.PackQty * SD.PackUnits),
	SoldBonus=-SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	SaleValue=-SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.PackQty * SD.PackUnits) * SD.SRPrice * 
			(1- SD.DiscPerc *.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01)),
	BonusValue=-SUM(SD.BonusQty * SD.SRPrice * (1- SD.DiscPerc *.01) * 
			(1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01)),
	Salesman=(SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SL.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode),
	U.UserName,
	Customer=AC.Name

FROM
	SRLedger SL,
	SRDetail SD,
	Item I,
	Users U,
	Accounts AC
WHERE
	SL.Date >= :ar_StartDate AND SL.Date <= :ar_EndDate AND
	SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	SL.SalesmanCode = U.UserCode AND
	SL.CustCode=AC.AccCode
GROUP BY
	SL.SRInvCode,
	SD.ICode,
	SL.Date,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	SL.SManCode,
	U.UserName,
	AC.Name
HAVING
	SUM(SD.BonusQty) > 0
ORDER BY
	INVCODE,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	SL.Date,
	U.UserName,
	AC.Name
